brief:
Settlers attacked a municipal crew from Qusra, south of Nablus, on Saturday while the workers were attempting to restore electricity to homes that had been cut off for approximately one week, Shehab Wire reported. Israeli occupation forces detained three members of the crew during the assault.

The attack targeted municipal employees who were working to reconnect power supplies to residences in the village that had been without electricity. The incident occurred as the crew carried out efforts to restore basic services to besieged households in the area.

title: Settlers attack Palestinian municipal workers attempting to restore power in Qusra
